<a id="a-worlds-reorderings-as-courses-of-growth--世界之重排作为生长之历程"></a>
# A world's reorderings as courses of growth

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`reorderings-as-courses-of-growth` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](reorderings-as-courses-of-growth.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With a footprint containing the exchanges, the numberings a world's reorderings give its first m steps are exactly the orders of birth of the courses of growth of its order of exchanges, so the laws of presence on that growth hold on the World; presence gives persistence, not conversely.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The exchanges of a stretch form a causal set: the first m steps, the exchange across i preceding that across j where both lie in the stretch and the order of joined exchanges relates them (exchanges, exchanges_ordered); a reordering of the stretch is a list of commutations within it, each of two exchanges not joined (Reordering). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.exchanges`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.exchanges_ordered`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.Reordering`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Its natural labellings are the renumberings of the stretch keeping the order of joined exchanges, with no hypothesis on the footprint: increasing along each joined pair, the earlier first, a renumbering increases along every chain of them (keeps_precedes, natural_iff). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.keeps_precedes`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.natural_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. The numberings a world's reorderings give a stretch are the orders of birth of the courses of growth of its order of exchanges: with the footprint containing the exchanges, a renumbering is a reordering's numbering exactly where it is a natural labelling, and exactly where a course of growth from the empty set relabels the exchanges onto its configuration at the stretch's size (reordering_iff_course). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.reordering_iff_course`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Each reordering is a natural labelling and each natural labelling a reordering's, so what is read on the stretch holds on every natural labelling, or on some, exactly where it holds on every reordering, or on some; where every two consecutive exchanges are joined, the only reordering is the world as it is (reordering_natural and four more). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.reordering_natural`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.natural_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.every_reordering_iff`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.some_reordering_iff`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.reordering_nil`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. A world whose footprint contains its exchanges, taking the stretch's exchanges in the order of a course of growth, with the same footprints and changes and the same start, agrees over the stretch with a reordering (course_converse, by Footprinted.converse). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.course_converse`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. The last link: an exchange precedes a later one exactly where it is joined to it, or precedes an exchange between them joined to it (last_of_precedes, precedes_iff_last). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.last_of_precedes`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_iff_last`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Joining decided on the stretch decides the order of exchanges on it, by search over the steps between, and joining weakly decided weakly decides it; precedence weakly decided on the stretch weakly decides that of its causal set (precedes_decided, precedes_weakly and their steps, exchanges_weakly). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_decided_below`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_decided`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_weakly_below`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_weakly`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.exchanges_weakly`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Below an exchange of the stretch, the links of its causal set are the links of the order of exchanges (links_exchanges). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.links_exchanges`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
9. Which of two exchanges a numbering takes first, its present at a stage and presence when an exchange is taken are read on the stretch (before_stretch, maximalBorn_stretch, presentAt_stretch). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.before_stretch`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.maximalBorn_stretch`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.presentAt_stretch`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. Taken before on every reordering: with no decision, exactly where the precedence is not refuted; with the pair's precedence decided, exactly where it holds (Szpilrajn read on the World), and so with joining decided on the stretch (every_reordering_not_not, precedes_iff_every_reordering, precedes_iff_every_reordering_of_joined). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.every_reordering_not_not`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_iff_every_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.precedes_iff_every_reordering_of_joined`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. Taken before on some reordering: with precedence weakly decided on the stretch, exactly where the two differ and the other does not precede the one, so two different unrelated exchanges are taken in either order (before_some_reordering, either_order_reordering). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.before_some_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.either_order_reordering`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. The present of any numbering at a stage is an antichain of the order of exchanges; with precedence weakly decided, every antichain given by a test is the present of some reordering, and two exchanges are present together on some reordering exactly where unrelated; with no decision, on every reordering exactly where, doubly negated, they precede the same exchanges of the stretch (present_unrelated and three more). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.present_unrelated`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.antichain_present_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.together_some_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.together_every_reordering_not_not`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
13. An exchange is present when another is taken on some reordering exactly where it is a link below it in the order of exchanges (precedence weakly decided), and on every reordering exactly where it is a link below it and a link below no other exchange of the stretch (no decision) (present_some_reordering, present_every_reordering). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.present_some_reordering`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.present_every_reordering`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
14. Presence on the world as it is is precedence with no exchange between joined to the earlier one; so, with the footprint containing the exchanges, an exchange present when another is taken leaves every relatum it touched shown then as right after its own step, on the world and on every reordering where it is present (present_identity_iff, persists_of_present and three more). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.first_of_precedes`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.present_identity_iff`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.sameAt_of_unmoved`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.persists_of_present`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.persists_of_present_reordering`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
15. Not conversely, through a dependence: in a world of three exchanges with an empty flow, whose middle exchange touches nothing the first touches and is joined to it through a dependence, what the first touched persists to the last step, yet on no reordering is the first present then (ByDependence and its laws). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.standing`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.web`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.dependent`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.touch`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.world`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.contains`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.joined_first_middle`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.joined_first_last`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.joined_middle_last`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.persists_not_present`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.ByDependence.only_reordering`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
16. Not conversely, with no dependence and the least footprint: in a world of four exchanges each touching only the relatum 0, which rises, rises, falls back and rises, the footprint touches only what moves, every two exchanges are joined, and what the first touched persists to the last step, yet the first is present then on no reordering (MovedBack and its laws). (`Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.standing`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.web`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.touch`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.world`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.contains`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.touches_moved`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.joined`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.persists_not_present`, `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth.MovedBack.only_reordering`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
17. The vee as a world: one exchange changing two relata, then one changing each; its order of exchanges is the vee of the present on causal-set growth, commuting the later two is a reordering, and the first is present when the last is taken on that reordering and not on the world as it is, the two numberings being by one course (VeeWorld and its laws). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The causal set of a stretch, its natural labellings, the last link, the decisions, presence on the world as it is, the present as an antichain and the witnesses take no hypothesis on the footprint; the representation, the laws on reorderings and persistence take the footprint containing the exchanges (Footprinted.Contains).
- Decisions are Prop-valued (the core's Decided and WeaklyDecided): joining decided or weakly decided for the pairs of the stretch gives precedence so decided; the laws on some reordering and on antichains take precedence weakly decided on the stretch; the law on every reordering takes the pair's precedence decided or none.
- Modelling choices: the stretch is the first m steps; the footprint is given, decided relatum by relatum, may touch a relatum it does not move, and the order of exchanges is relative to it; presence is read as the present on causal-set growth reads it; antichains are given by a Boolean test; the witnesses' flows are empty; pointwise, with no function extensionality.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Anything about processes without a footprint, continuous time, infinite stretches, stretches from another step, or the present of a center.
- The laws of the present on causal-set growth that take a Decidable instance of the whole precedence, on the World; three of their forms with no decision are instanced, and past_every_iff has none.
- A representation of the World through the order of joined exchanges: the World's representation theorem (the-world-represented-both-ways) reads the shared index, and this is one aspect of it, the interleavings.
- That the World gives the footprint: it is supplied, and the order of exchanges is relative to it.
- Which presence or which reordering is better.
- **Counterexample:** In a world of three exchanges whose middle exchange is joined to the first only through a dependence, what the first touched persists to the last step, yet on no reordering is the first present when the last is taken (ByDependence.persists_not_present). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReorderingGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** In a world of four exchanges on one relatum, moved and moved back, with no dependence and the least footprint, what the first touched persists to the last step, yet the first is present then on no reordering (MovedBack.persists_not_present). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReorderingGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** On the vee as a world the first exchange is present when the last is taken on one reordering and not on the world as it is, the two numberings being by one course (VeeWorld.presence_varies, VeeWorld.one_course_two_numberings). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReorderingGrowth.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Trace theory: the linear extensions of a trace's dependence order are exactly its interleavings (Mazurkiewicz 1977; Diekert and Rozenberg 1995), here the World's own form of it (Footprinted.sorts_iff, landed), and the prefixes of a trace correspond to the down-sets of its dependence order, the configurations of its event structure (Nielsen, Plotkin and Winskel 1981). Szpilrajn's extension theorem in Dushnik and Miller's intersection form (1930, 1941) gives the law on every reordering. Causal set theory reads the natural labellings as the paths of sequential growth (Rideout and Sorkin 2000); the composition follows at once from these two facts, and a light search found no paper connecting traces with causal-set growth. Presence giving persistence is an elementary consequence of a footprint containing the exchanges. Graded in UE15's NOTE.
